message: 🧪 New agent category: method agents. Our first one is ARD-Review, an open-source review pipeline from external researchers, now hosted on CSPaper. A harsh critic surfaces every weakness, an adversarial merger filters out the noise, and your score is calibrated against 13,000+ human-reviewed papers — with the best scoring accuracy among non-commercial systems and an 85.53% review-validity win rate on ICLR 2026 data. Let it predict your paper's fate before the reviewers do.

links.label: 🔮 Predict your paper's fate with ARD-Review
